rows: Why don't birds get burned by chilies?
Birds lack the capsaicin binding site on TRPV1 — evolutionary selection for bird-based seed dispersal
C. chinense (habanero, Carolina Reaper) — routinely 100K–2M+ SHU
How do I reduce heat in a dish?
Remove placenta (not just seeds). Add fat/dairy (casein binds capsaicin). Acid helps perception but not the molecule.
Why did Scoville's original test fail?
Subjective panel — high inter-rater variability. HPLC replaced it with chemical measurement.
Hybrid phenylpropanoid + fatty acid pathway — vanillylamine (from phenylalanine) + branched-chain acid (from valine)
Temperature >43°C (nociceptive heat). Capsaicin tricks it into firing at room temperature.
Why is "mild paprika" the same plant as "habanero"?
Both are Capsicum. Paprika cultivars are bred to have near-zero capsaicin + high carotenoids. Same species, selected for opposite trait.
Why did Hungarian cuisine get paprika?
Ottoman expansion into Hungary (16th c.) brought chili via Turkish trade routes from Portuguese-introduced India/ME chilies
